messages.subject: Moderating variable
parts:
Hello, i am trying to create a model with latente variables in Rstudio, I succeed to create those variables but i cannot succeed to create a moderation with it.

myModel <- "demo =~ demo_idea1 + demo_idea2 + demo_idea3 + demo_idea4 + demo_principle1 + demo_principle2 + demo_principle3 + demo_principle4
            support_norm =~ canor_support1 + canor_support2 + canor_support3 + canor_support4 + canor_support5 + canor_support6 + canor_support7 + canor_support8 + canor_support9
            support_vio =~ cavio_support1 + cavio_support2
            support_norm ~ anger_antimigrants + frearful_antimigrants + outrage_treatment_migrants + sympathy_migrants
            support_vio ~ anger_antimigrants + frearful_antimigrants + outrage_treatment_migrants + sympathy_migrants
            support_norm ~ anger_antimigrants + frearful_antimigrants + outrage_treatment_migrants + sympathy_migrants
            support_vio ~ demo"

"demo" is my modearting variable
anger_antimigrants, frearful_antimigrants, outrage_treatment_migrants and sympathy_migrants are my independant variables
and support_norm and support_vio are my dependant variables.

Thank you in advance !

messages.author: 628053524651bedc
messages.subject: Re: Moderating variable
parts:
First of all, I would recommend to write your regression together.
For example,

+ demo.


What wou are missing is the interaction term of demo and for example
a) anger_antimigrants
b) frearful_antimigrants
c) outrage_treatment_migrants
d) sympathy_migrants

You can calculate the relevant indicator products by the the indprod() function.
You then specify the interaction terms as above with =~ and include the latent interaction in your regression.
